● After a character has been set as a Build Target, the Build Target menu will display the following content:
    The amount of material still needed to finish character building, their sources, and the amount of material that can only be obtained via using Trailblaze Power.

● When the Build Target is in the "Preview" state, the "Only calculate Traces that are recommended to level up" will not be active.

◆ Relic Recommendation Rules ◆
● The recommended Relics will be selected during the Relic data calculation process via default system data collected.
● After the Relic data calculation is completed, Relics will be recommended based on active player usage rates.

◆ Build Target Setting Rules ◆
● The Build Target for the Survival Index and Character Guide will be kept the same.
● Characters that can be set as the Build Target include:
    Owned characters
